title: 1945 Prairie's front door now stands under its round arch
items: The Armour-Corwith house at 1945 Prairie gets the round-arched doorway its 1928 newspaper photograph shows: a pair of doors under a fanlight, set back in the brick.
The arch carries the same stone band and keystone as the round-headed windows beside it, so the principal storey reads as one row of arches.
